verdict.rationale: Visalaw AI, the firm's own product, claims it can "automate entire workflows" and has added a Research Agent. That is a glancing first-party claim of automation, but nothing shows those automations run autonomously in the background or on a recurring schedule rather than as one-off, user-prompted tasks. missing for 10: documented background/unattended execution, scheduled or recurring triggers, automation setup/configuration docs, any API or integration surface (llms.txt and OpenAPI probes return 404), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Analyze complex documents and automate entire workflows.
